bio: Undergraduate B.Tech Computer Science & Engineering student at SRM University-AP with a strong focus on media handling, graphic design, and digital content creation. Serving as Media Manager Head for CONNECT SRM AP and Graphic Designer for Microsoft Student Community (MSC), leading creative teams, managing social channels, and delivering high-quality video and design campaigns.

bullets: Lead the media and content creation team for campus events, digital campaigns, and promotions.
Manage end-to-end social media content, creative posters, and high-impact video promotions.
Ensure brand consistency, design guidelines, and message alignment across all digital and physical channels.
experience.desc: Leading media operations, promotions, and brand design for university student community.

bullets: Design eye-catching posters, banners, and social media creatives for technical events and bootcamps.
Create engaging promotional visuals to increase student turnout and online community engagement.
Collaborate with marketing and technical teams to maintain visual excellence and brand guidelines.
experience.desc: Designing visual promotional materials and event assets for the Microsoft Student Community.

bullets: Deliver professional design and high-end video editing services to online and offline clients.
Design logos, brand identities, posters, banners, and promotional marketing materials.
Edit highly engaging short-form and long-form video content for YouTube, Reels, and social media.
experience.desc: Freelance creative services delivering custom logos, marketing assets, and engaging video edits.

bullets: Worked in studio environments on real client projects delivering print and digital creative assets.
Performed video editing tasks, background enhancements, cuts, transitions, and color correction.
Assisted senior designers and art directors in branding and content production workflows.
experience.desc: Agency and studio-based design and video post-production support for client marketing campaigns.
